en.R: With you I smash men and women. \q With you I smash old people and young people. \q With you I smash young men and young women.

es.L: y contigo quebranto hombre y mujer, \q y contigo quebranto viejo y muchacho, \q y contigo quebranto joven y doncella;
es.B: contigo quebranto hombre y mujer; \q contigo quebranto viejo y niño; \q contigo quebranto joven y muchacha;
es.R: Contigo hago pedazos a hombres y mujeres. \q Contigo hago pedazos a viejos y niños. \q Contigo hago pedazos a muchachos y muchachas.

fr.L: et par toi je brise l’homme et la femme, \q et par toi je brise le vieillard et le jeune garçon, \q et par toi je brise le jeune homme et la jeune fille ;
fr.B: par toi je brise l’homme et la femme ; \q par toi je brise le vieillard et l’enfant ; \q par toi je brise le jeune homme et la jeune fille ;
fr.R: Avec toi, j’écrase les hommes et les femmes. \q Avec toi, j’écrase les vieux et les jeunes. \q Avec toi, j’écrase les jeunes gens et les jeunes filles.

sw.L: na kwa wewe ninavunjavunja mwanamume na mwanamke, \q na kwa wewe ninavunjavunja mzee na kijana, \q na kwa wewe ninavunjavunja kijana na msichana;
sw.B: kwa wewe ninavunjavunja mwanamume na mwanamke; \q kwa wewe ninavunjavunja mzee na kijana; \q kwa wewe ninavunjavunja kijana na msichana;
sw.R: Kwa wewe ninawaponda wanaume na wanawake. \q Kwa wewe ninawaponda wazee na vijana. \q Kwa wewe ninawaponda vijana wa kiume na wasichana.

decisions.choice: pairs that take in everyone
decisions.reason: The pairs, man and woman, old and young, young man and young woman, are a way of saying "all people" (compare 6:11). The word for "young" in the second pair often means a boy or youth.

decisions.choice: the repeated phrase kept
decisions.reason: As in verse 20.

source.text: וְנִפַּצְתִּ֤י בְךָ֙ רֹעֶ֣ה וְעֶדְר֔וֹ וְנִפַּצְתִּ֥י בְךָ֖ אִכָּ֣ר וְצִמְדּ֑וֹ וְנִפַּצְתִּ֣י בְךָ֔ פַּח֖וֹת וּסְגָנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And I shatter with you shepherd and his flock, and I shatter with you farmer and his team, and I shatter with you governors and officials.

en.L: and with you I shatter shepherd and his flock, \q and with you I shatter farmer and his team, \q and with you I shatter governors and officials.
en.B: with you I shatter shepherd and flock; \q with you I shatter farmer and team of oxen; \q with you I shatter governors and officials.
en.R: With you I smash shepherds and their flocks. \q With you I smash farmers and the oxen that pull their plows. \q With you I smash governors and officials.

es.L: y contigo quebranto pastor y su rebaño, \q y contigo quebranto labrador y su yunta, \q y contigo quebranto gobernadores y magistrados.
es.B: contigo quebranto pastor y rebaño; \q contigo quebranto labrador y yunta de bueyes; \q contigo quebranto gobernadores y magistrados.
es.R: Contigo hago pedazos a los pastores y a sus rebaños. \q Contigo hago pedazos a los agricultores y a los bueyes que tiran de sus arados. \q Contigo hago pedazos a gobernadores y funcionarios.

fr.L: et par toi je brise le berger et son troupeau, \q et par toi je brise le laboureur et son attelage, \q et par toi je brise les gouverneurs et les magistrats.
fr.B: par toi je brise berger et troupeau ; \q par toi je brise laboureur et attelage de bœufs ; \q par toi je brise gouverneurs et magistrats.
fr.R: Avec toi, j’écrase les bergers et leurs troupeaux. \q Avec toi, j’écrase les paysans et les bœufs qui tirent leur charrue. \q Avec toi, j’écrase les gouverneurs et les magistrats.

sw.L: na kwa wewe ninavunjavunja mchungaji na kundi lake, \q na kwa wewe ninavunjavunja mkulima na jozi yake ya ng'ombe, \q na kwa wewe ninavunjavunja maliwali na maafisa.
sw.B: kwa wewe ninavunjavunja mchungaji na kundi; \q kwa wewe ninavunjavunja mkulima na jozi ya ng'ombe wa kulimia; \q kwa wewe ninavunjavunja maliwali na maafisa.
sw.R: Kwa wewe ninawaponda wachungaji na makundi yao. \q Kwa wewe ninawaponda wakulima na ng'ombe wanaovuta majembe yao. \q Kwa wewe ninawaponda maliwali na maafisa.

decisions.choice: his team: the pair of oxen yoked to the plow
decisions.reason: The word means a pair, a yoke of oxen working together (1 Samuel 11:7; 1 Kings 19:19).

decisions.choice: governors and officials: titles of rulers in the empires of the day
decisions.reason: Both words came into Hebrew from the language of Assyria and Babylon. They name provincial governors and lesser officials (verses 28, 57; Isaiah 41:25; Ezekiel 23:6). The list runs from the herdsman to the rulers: no one is beyond the club's reach.

decisions.choice: team of oxen (B); the oxen that pull their plows (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the team is (m1).

source.text: וְשִׁלַּמְתִּ֨י לְבָבֶ֜ל וּלְכֹ֣ל׀יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י כַשְׂדִּ֗ים אֵ֧ת כָּל־רָעָתָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂ֥וּ בְצִיּ֖וֹן לְעֵֽינֵיכֶ֑ם נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I will repay to Babylon and to all [the] inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they did in Zion before your eyes, declares Yahweh.

en.L: And I will repay Babylon and all the inhabitants of Chaldea \q for all their evil that they have done in Zion before your eyes, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: But I will repay Babylon and all who live in Chaldea \q for all the evil they have done in Zion before your eyes, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: But I will pay back Babylon and all the people of Babylonia \q for all the evil they did in Jerusalem while you watched, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y pagaré a Babilonia y a todos los habitantes de Caldea \q todo el mal que hicieron en Sion delante de {{plural_you:sus ojos|vuestros ojos}}, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Pero pagaré a Babilonia y a todos los que viven en Caldea \q por todo el mal que han hecho en Sion delante de {{plural_you:sus ojos|vuestros ojos}}, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Pero le daré su merecido a Babilonia y a toda la gente de Babilonia \q por todo el mal que hicieron en Jerusalén mientras {{plural_you:ustedes miraban|vosotros mirabais}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et je rendrai à Babylone et à tous les habitants de la Chaldée \q tout le mal qu’ils ont fait dans Sion sous vos yeux, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Mais je rendrai à Babylone et à tous les habitants de la Chaldée \q tout le mal qu’ils ont fait dans Sion sous vos yeux, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Mais je ferai payer Babylone et tous les habitants de la Babylonie \q pour tout le mal qu’ils ont fait à Jérusalem sous vos yeux, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nami nitailipa Babeli na wakaaji wote wa Ukaldayo \q kwa ajili ya mabaya yao yote waliyoyatenda katika Sayuni mbele ya macho yenu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Lakini nitailipa Babeli na wote wanaoishi Ukaldayo \q kwa ajili ya mabaya yote waliyoyatenda katika Sayuni mbele ya macho yenu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Lakini nitailipiza Babeli na watu wote wa nchi ya Babeli \q kwa ajili ya mabaya yote waliyoyatenda Yerusalemu mkiwa mnatazama, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: and I will repay: the turn from Babylon's past use to its punishment
decisions.reason: After the ten blows of verses 20-23, the LORD declares that the weapon he used will itself be repaid. The verb is the one used in verses 6 and 56.

decisions.choice: before your eyes: the evil done in Zion while you, the exiles, watched
alternatives: I will repay them before your eyes
decisions.reason: The "your" is plural and speaks to the people of Judah. The phrase most naturally goes with what comes just before it, the evil done in Zion, which they saw with their own eyes. It could also go with the repaying: they will see Babylon punished (50:28).

decisions.choice: Jerusalem; Babylonia; while you watched
decisions.reason: Readable says "Jerusalem" for Zion and "Babylonia" for Chaldea, and "while you watched" for "before your eyes" (m2).

decisions.choice: plural_you (sus ojos / vuestros ojos)
decisions.reason: "Your eyes" is plural: God turns to the people of Judah, who saw what Babylon did.

source.text: הִנְנִ֨י אֵלֶ֜יךָ הַ֤ר הַמַּשְׁחִית֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה הַמַּשְׁחִ֖ית אֶת־כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְנָטִ֨יתִי אֶת־יָדִ֜י עָלֶ֗יךָ וְגִלְגַּלְתִּ֨יךָ֙ מִן־הַסְּלָעִ֔ים וּנְתַתִּ֖יךָ לְהַ֥ר שְׂרֵפָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Here I [am] against you, mountain of the destroyer, declares Yahweh, the [one] destroying all the earth; and I will stretch out my hand against you and roll you from the crags and make you a mountain of burning.

en.L: Look, I am against you, O destroying mountain, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q you who destroy all the earth; \q and I will stretch out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against you and roll you down from the crags, \q and make you a burned mountain.
en.B: I am against you, destroying mountain, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q you who destroy the whole earth. \q I will stretch out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against you and roll you down from the cliffs, \q and make you a burned-out mountain.
en.R: Babylon, you are like a mountain that destroys the whole earth. \q But now I am against you, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q I will reach out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against you and roll you down from the cliffs. \q I will make you a mountain burned to ashes.

es.L: He aquí, yo estoy contra ti, monte destructor, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q que destruyes toda la tierra; \q y extenderé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra ti y te haré rodar de las peñas, \q y te convertiré en monte quemado.
es.B: Estoy contra ti, monte destructor, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q tú que destruyes toda la tierra. \q Extenderé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra ti y te haré rodar desde los peñascos, \q y te convertiré en un monte calcinado.
es.R: Babilonia, eres como un monte que destruye toda la tierra. \q Pero ahora yo estoy contra ti, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Extenderé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra ti y te haré rodar desde los peñascos. \q Te convertiré en un monte reducido a cenizas.

fr.L: Voici, je suis contre toi, montagne de destruction, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q toi qui détruis toute la terre ; \q et j’étendrai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre toi, et je te roulerai du haut des rochers, \q et je ferai de toi une montagne brûlée.
fr.B: Je suis contre toi, montagne destructrice, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q toi qui détruis la terre entière. \q J’étendrai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre toi, je te ferai rouler du haut des falaises, \q et je ferai de toi une montagne calcinée.
fr.R: Babylone, tu es comme une montagne qui détruit toute la terre. \q Mais maintenant je suis contre toi, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q J’étendrai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre toi et je te ferai rouler du haut des falaises. \q Je ferai de toi une montagne réduite en cendres.

sw.L: Tazama, mimi ni juu yako, ewe mlima uharibuo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q wewe uiharibuye dunia yote; \q nami nitaunyosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu yako na kukuvingirisha kutoka katika miamba, \q na kukufanya mlima ulioteketezwa.
sw.B: Mimi niko dhidi yako, ewe mlima uharibuo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q wewe uiharibuye dunia yote. \q Nitaunyosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} dhidi yako na kukuvingirisha kutoka kwenye majabali, \q na kukufanya mlima ulioteketea.
sw.R: Ewe Babeli, wewe ni kama mlima unaoiharibu dunia yote. \q Lakini sasa mimi niko dhidi yako, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Nitaunyosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} dhidi yako na kukuvingirisha kutoka kwenye majabali. \q Nitakufanya mlima ulioungua mpaka ukawa majivu.

decisions.choice: destroying mountain: Babylon as a towering power that ruins the earth
decisions.reason: Babylon stood on a flat plain, so the mountain is a picture of its height and power, the empire that loomed over the nations (compare Daniel 2:35). The word "destroying" is the one used in verse 1 of the wind God sends: the destroyer is now destroyed. The same phrase names a hill near Jerusalem where Solomon built shrines to foreign gods (2 Kings 23:13), but there is no clear link here.

decisions.choice: rolled from the crags ... a burned mountain: a peak toppled and burned out
decisions.reason: The picture may be of a mountain set on fire and left a heap of burned rock, or of a fortress on the heights thrown down and burned. Either way, Babylon will be left lifeless, good for nothing (verse 26; compare Revelation 8:8).

decisions.choice: stretch out my hand against you: act in judgment
decisions.reason: The phrase is used of the LORD striking a people (6:12; 15:6; Exodus 7:5).

decisions.choice: Babylon, you are like a mountain
decisions.reason: Readable names Babylon and says "like" to show that the mountain is a picture (m1). It puts "says the LORD" in the second sentence so the first can explain the picture.

source.text: וְלֹֽא־יִקְח֤וּ מִמְּךָ֙ אֶ֣בֶן לְפִנָּ֔ה וְאֶ֖בֶן לְמֽוֹסָד֑וֹת כִּֽי־שִׁמְמ֥וֹת עוֹלָ֛ם תִּֽהְיֶ֖ה נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And not they will take from you a stone for a corner, or a stone for foundations; for desolations of forever you will be, declares Yahweh.

en.L: And they will not take from you a stone for a corner \q or a stone for foundations, \q for you will be a desolation forever, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: No one will take a cornerstone from you, \q or any stone for a foundation, \q for you will be a desolation forever, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: No one will take a single stone from you \q to build the corner or the foundation of a house. \q You will be an empty ruin forever, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y no tomarán de ti piedra para esquina \q ni piedra para cimientos, \q porque serás desolación perpetua, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Nadie sacará de ti una piedra angular \q ni una piedra para cimientos, \q porque serás una desolación para siempre, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Nadie sacará de ti ni una sola piedra \q para construir la esquina o los cimientos de una casa. \q Serás una ruina vacía para siempre, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et on ne prendra pas de toi une pierre pour l’angle, \q ni une pierre pour les fondations, \q car tu seras une désolation pour toujours, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: On ne tirera de toi ni pierre d’angle \q ni pierre de fondation, \q car tu seras une désolation pour toujours, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Personne ne prendra chez toi une seule pierre \q pour construire l’angle ou les fondations d’une maison. \q Tu seras une ruine vide pour toujours, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Wala hawatachukua kwako jiwe la pembeni, \q wala jiwe la misingi, \q kwa maana utakuwa ukiwa wa milele, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Hakuna atakayechukua kwako jiwe la pembeni, \q wala jiwe lolote la msingi, \q kwa maana utakuwa ukiwa milele, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Hakuna mtu atakayechukua hata jiwe moja kwako \q ili kujenga pembe au msingi wa nyumba. \q Utakuwa magofu matupu milele, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: a stone for a corner or for foundations: the best stones, used to start a building
decisions.reason: The cornerstone and foundation stones had to be large and sound (Isaiah 28:16; Psalm 118:22). A burned mountain would yield no stone good enough even for that: nothing in Babylon will be fit to build again.

decisions.choice: a desolation forever: a ruin that will last
decisions.reason: The plural "desolations" stresses how complete the ruin is. Verse 62 uses the same words.

decisions.choice: to build the corner or the foundation of a house
decisions.reason: Readable says what the stones are used for (m1).

source.text: שְׂאוּ־נֵ֣ס בָּאָ֗רֶץ תִּקְע֨וּ שׁוֹפָ֤ר בַּגּוֹיִם֙ קַדְּשׁ֤וּ עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם הַשְׁמִ֧יעוּ עָלֶ֛יהָ מַמְלְכ֥וֹת אֲרָרַ֖ט מִנִּ֣י וְאַשְׁכְּנָ֑ז פִּקְד֤וּ עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ טִפְסָ֔ר הַֽעֲלוּ־ס֖וּס כְּיֶ֥לֶק סָמָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Lift up a signal flag in the land; blow a horn among [the] nations; consecrate against her nations; summon against her [the] kingdoms of Ararat, Minni and Ashkenaz; appoint against her a marshal; bring up horse like bristling locusts.

en.L: Raise a signal flag in the land; blow the trumpet among the nations; consecrate nations against her; \q summon against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni and Ashkenaz; \q appoint a marshal against her; \q bring up horses like bristling locusts.
en.B: Raise a signal flag in the land! Sound the ram's horn among the nations! Set apart nations for holy war against her; \q summon against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni and Ashkenaz! \q Appoint a commander against her; \q send up horses like a swarm of bristling locusts!
en.R: Raise a signal flag in the land! Blow the trumpet among the nations! Get the nations ready to fight against Babylon. \q Call the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni and Ashkenaz to attack her. \q Choose a commander to lead the attack. \q Send so many horses that they look like a swarm of locusts.

es.L: {{plural_you:Alcen|Alzad}} bandera en la tierra; {{plural_you:toquen|tocad}} trompeta entre las naciones; {{plural_you:consagren|consagrad}} naciones contra ella; \q {{plural_you:convoquen|convocad}} contra ella a los reinos de Ararat, Mini y Askenaz; \q {{plural_you:nombren|nombrad}} contra ella un capitán; \q {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} subir caballos como langostas erizadas.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Alcen|Alzad}} una bandera en la tierra! ¡{{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} el cuerno de carnero entre las naciones! {{plural_you:Preparen|Preparad}} a las naciones para la guerra santa contra ella; \q ¡{{plural_you:convoquen|convocad}} contra ella a los reinos de Ararat, Mini y Askenaz! \q {{plural_you:Nombren|Nombrad}} un comandante contra ella; \q ¡{{plural_you:hagan|haced}} subir caballos como un enjambre de langostas erizadas!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Alcen|Alzad}} una bandera en la tierra! ¡{{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} la trompeta entre las naciones! {{plural_you:Preparen|Preparad}} a las naciones para pelear contra Babilonia. \q {{plural_you:Llamen|Llamad}} a los reinos de Ararat, Mini y Askenaz para que la ataquen. \q {{plural_you:Escojan|Escoged}} un comandante que dirija el ataque. \q {{plural_you:Envíen|Enviad}} tantos caballos que parezcan un enjambre de langostas.

fr.L: Levez un étendard dans le pays ; sonnez du cor parmi les nations ; consacrez des nations contre elle ; \q convoquez contre elle les royaumes d’Ararat, de Minni et d’Ashkenaz ; \q établissez contre elle un chef de guerre ; \q faites monter des chevaux comme des sauterelles hérissées.
fr.B: Levez un étendard dans le pays ! Sonnez du cor parmi les nations ! Préparez des nations à la guerre sainte contre elle ; \q appelez contre elle les royaumes d’Ararat, de Minni et d’Ashkenaz ! \q Nommez un commandant contre elle ; \q faites monter des chevaux comme un essaim de sauterelles hérissées !
fr.R: Levez un drapeau dans le pays ! Sonnez de la trompette parmi les nations ! Préparez les nations à combattre Babylone. \q Appelez les royaumes d’Ararat, de Minni et d’Ashkenaz à l’attaquer. \q Choisissez un commandant pour mener l’attaque. \q Envoyez tant de chevaux qu’on dirait un nuage de sauterelles.

sw.L: Inueni bendera katika nchi; pigeni baragumu kati ya mataifa; yawekeni mataifa wakfu juu yake; \q iteni juu yake falme za Ararati, Mini na Ashkenazi; \q wekeni jemadari juu yake; \q pandisheni farasi kama nzige wenye manyoya magumu.
sw.B: Inueni bendera katika nchi! Pigeni baragumu kati ya mataifa! Yawekeni mataifa tayari kwa vita vitakatifu dhidi yake; \q iteni juu yake falme za Ararati, Mini na Ashkenazi! \q Wekeni kamanda dhidi yake; \q leteni farasi wengi kama kundi la nzige wenye manyoya magumu!
sw.R: Inueni bendera katika nchi! Pigeni baragumu kati ya mataifa! Yaandaeni mataifa kupigana na Babeli. \q Ziiteni falme za Ararati, Mini na Ashkenazi zimshambulie. \q Chagueni kamanda wa kuongoza mashambulizi. \q Pelekeni farasi wengi sana hata waonekane kama kundi la nzige.

decisions.choice: Ararat, Minni and Ashkenaz: peoples of the mountains north of Babylon
decisions.reason: Ararat is the kingdom of Urartu, in the mountains of what is now Armenia and eastern Turkey (Genesis 8:4; 2 Kings 19:37). Minni is the land of the Manneans, south of Lake Urmia. Ashkenaz is usually linked with the Scythians, horsemen of the north (Genesis 10:3). In the sixth century BC these lands were under the rule of the Medes (verse 28), who would bring them against Babylon.

decisions.choice: consecrate: prepare for war with religious rites
decisions.reason: War was begun with sacrifices and acts that set the soldiers apart, so the verb "make holy" came to mean "prepare for battle" (6:4; 22:7; Joel 4:9).

decisions.choice: marshal: an officer who musters troops
decisions.reason: The word, borrowed from the language of Babylon, names an official, here one who calls up and arranges an army. It appears only here and in Nahum 3:17.

decisions.choice: bristling locusts: locusts at a stage when their wings stand up stiff
decisions.reason: The word for "bristling" is used only here and may describe young locusts whose wings are still in stiff sheaths, or the rough hair of the horses' manes. Either way, the cavalry comes like a swarm (verse 14).

decisions.choice: ram's horn (B); Prepare the nations for holy war (B); commander (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "ram's horn" for the *shofar*, as Isaiah does. Balanced and Readable say what "consecrate" means here (m2) and use "commander" for the marshal.

decisions.choice: consagren naciones (L); preparen a las naciones para la guerra santa (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Consecrate" here means to prepare for a holy war; Literal keeps the word.

source.text: קַדְּשׁ֨וּ עָלֶ֤יהָ גוֹיִם֙ אֶת־מַלְכֵ֣י מָדַ֔י אֶת־פַּחוֹתֶ֖יהָ וְאֶת־כָּל־סְגָנֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־אֶ֥רֶץ מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Consecrate against her nations, [the] kings of Media, her governors and all her officials and all [the] land of his dominion.

en.L: Consecrate nations against her, the kings of the Medes, \q their governors and all their officials, \q and all the land of their dominion.
en.B: Set apart nations for holy war against her: the kings of the Medes, \q with their governors and all their officials, \q and every land they rule.
en.R: Get the nations ready to fight against Babylon: the kings of the Medes, \q together with their governors and officials, \q and all the lands under their rule.

es.L: {{plural_you:Consagren|Consagrad}} contra ella naciones, a los reyes de los medos, \q a sus gobernadores y a todos sus magistrados, \q y a toda la tierra de su dominio.
es.B: {{plural_you:Preparen|Preparad}} a las naciones para la guerra santa contra ella: a los reyes de los medos, \q con sus gobernadores y todos sus funcionarios, \q y a todas las tierras que dominan.
es.R: {{plural_you:Preparen|Preparad}} a las naciones para pelear contra Babilonia: a los reyes de los medos, \q junto con sus gobernadores y funcionarios, \q y a todas las tierras que gobiernan.

fr.L: Consacrez contre elle des nations, les rois des Mèdes, \q leurs gouverneurs et tous leurs magistrats, \q et tout le pays de leur domination.
fr.B: Préparez des nations à la guerre sainte contre elle : les rois des Mèdes, \q avec leurs gouverneurs et tous leurs magistrats, \q et tous les pays qu’ils dominent.
fr.R: Préparez les nations à combattre Babylone : les rois des Mèdes, \q avec leurs gouverneurs et leurs magistrats, \q et tous les pays qu’ils gouvernent.

sw.L: Yawekeni mataifa wakfu juu yake, wafalme wa Wamedi, \q maliwali wao na maafisa wao wote, \q na nchi yote ya mamlaka yao.
sw.B: Yawekeni mataifa tayari kwa vita vitakatifu dhidi yake: wafalme wa Wamedi, \q pamoja na maliwali wao na maafisa wao wote, \q na kila nchi wanayoitawala.
sw.R: Yaandaeni mataifa kupigana na Babeli: wafalme wa Wamedi, \q pamoja na maliwali wao na maafisa wao, \q na nchi zote zilizo chini ya utawala wao.

decisions.choice: her governors ... his dominion: the rulers and lands under Media
decisions.reason: The pronouns shift: "her" refers to Media as a land, and "his" to its king, or to each king. The sense is the whole Median empire with all its subject peoples.

decisions.choice: governors and officials
decisions.reason: As in verse 23. Media's governors and officials ruled the lands named in verse 27.

decisions.choice: their governors ... their dominion
decisions.reason: English uses "their" for the shifting pronouns (m1), since they all point to the Medes and their kings.

source.text: וַתִּרְעַ֥שׁ הָאָ֖רֶץ וַתָּחֹ֑ל כִּ֣י קָ֤מָה עַל־בָּבֶל֙ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת יְהוָ֔ה לָשׂ֞וּם אֶת־אֶ֧רֶץ בָּבֶ֛ל לְשַׁמָּ֖ה מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃

records.literal_gloss: And quakes the land and writhes, for stand against Babylon [the] plans of Yahweh to make [the] land of Babylon a desolation without inhabitant.

en.L: And the land quakes and writhes, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s plans against Babylon stand, \q to make the land of Babylon a desolation without inhabitant.
en.B: The land trembles and writhes in pain, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s plans against Babylon stand firm: \q to make the land of Babylon a wasteland where no one lives.
en.R: The land shakes and twists in pain, \q because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} planned against Babylon. \q He will make the land of Babylon an empty wasteland where no one lives.

es.L: Y tiembla la tierra y se retuerce, \q porque se cumplen contra Babilonia los designios {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q para convertir la tierra de Babilonia en desolación sin habitante.
es.B: La tierra tiembla y se retuerce de dolor, \q porque los planes {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} contra Babilonia siguen firmes: \q convertir la tierra de Babilonia en un desierto donde nadie viva.
es.R: La tierra tiembla y se retuerce de dolor, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará lo que planeó contra Babilonia. \q Convertirá la tierra de Babilonia en un desierto vacío donde nadie vive.

fr.L: Et la terre tremble et se tord, \q car les desseins {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} contre Babylone s’accomplissent, \q pour faire du pays de Babylone une désolation sans habitant.
fr.B: La terre tremble et se tord de douleur, \q car les desseins {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} contre Babylone tiennent bon : \q faire du pays de Babylone un désert où personne n’habite.
fr.R: La terre tremble et se tord de douleur, \q parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} va faire ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a prévu contre Babylone. \q Il fera du pays de Babylone un désert vide où personne n’habite.

sw.L: Nayo nchi inatetemeka na kugaagaa kwa maumivu, \q kwa maana mipango ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} juu ya Babeli inasimama, \q kuifanya nchi ya Babeli kuwa ukiwa bila mkaaji.
sw.B: Nchi inatetemeka na kugaagaa kwa uchungu, \q kwa maana mipango ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhidi ya Babeli inasimama imara: \q kuifanya nchi ya Babeli nyika isiyo na mtu anayeishi humo.
sw.R: Nchi inatikisika na kujipinda kwa maumivu, \q kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atafanya yale aliyoyapanga dhidi ya Babeli. \q Ataifanya nchi ya Babeli kuwa nyika tupu isiyo na mtu.

decisions.choice: writhes: twists in pain, as in childbirth
decisions.reason: The verb is used of a woman in labor (4:31) and of the earth shaking at God's coming (Psalm 97:4). The land of Babylon shakes at what is coming.

decisions.choice: stand: are carried out and cannot be changed
decisions.reason: A plan that "stands" holds firm and comes to pass (44:28-29; Isaiah 14:24; 46:10).

decisions.choice: will do what he planned
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what it means for a plan to stand (m2).

source.text: חָדְלוּ֩ גִבּוֹרֵ֨י בָבֶ֜ל לְהִלָּחֵ֗ם יָֽשְׁבוּ֙ בַּמְּצָד֔וֹת נָשְׁתָ֥ה גְבוּרָתָ֖ם הָי֣וּ לְנָשִׁ֑ים הִצִּ֥יתוּ מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶ֖יהָ נִשְׁבְּר֥וּ בְרִיחֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Cease [the] warriors of Babylon to fight; they sit in the strongholds; dried up [is] their strength; they have become women; they have set on fire her dwellings; broken [are] her bars.

en.L: The warriors of Babylon have ceased to fight; they sit in the strongholds; \q their strength has dried up; they have become women; \q her dwellings are set on fire; her bars are broken.
en.B: Babylon's warriors have stopped fighting; they stay in their strongholds. \q Their strength is gone; they have become like women. \q Her houses are set on fire; the bars of her gates are broken.
en.R: Babylon's soldiers have stopped fighting. They stay inside their forts. \q Their strength is gone. They have lost all their courage. \q Her houses are burning. The bars that lock her gates are broken.

es.L: Los valientes de Babilonia dejaron de pelear; se quedan en las fortalezas; \q se agotó su fuerza; se volvieron como mujeres; \q incendiaron sus moradas; quebrados están sus cerrojos.
es.B: Los guerreros de Babilonia han dejado de pelear; se quedan en sus fortalezas. \q Se les acabó la fuerza; se han vuelto como mujeres. \q Sus casas han sido incendiadas; los cerrojos de sus puertas están rotos.
es.R: Los soldados de Babilonia han dejado de pelear. Se quedan dentro de sus fuertes. \q Se les acabó la fuerza. Han perdido todo el valor. \q Sus casas están ardiendo. Las trancas de sus puertas están rotas.

fr.L: Les guerriers de Babylone ont cessé de combattre ; ils restent dans les forteresses ; \q leur force s’est tarie ; ils sont devenus des femmes ; \q on a mis le feu à ses demeures ; ses verrous sont brisés.
fr.B: Les guerriers de Babylone ont cessé le combat ; ils restent dans leurs forteresses. \q Leur force est épuisée ; ils sont devenus comme des femmes. \q Ses maisons sont incendiées, les verrous de ses portes sont brisés.
fr.R: Les soldats de Babylone ont cessé de se battre. Ils restent dans leurs forteresses. \q Ils n’ont plus de force. Ils ont perdu tout courage. \q Ses maisons brûlent. Les barres qui ferment ses portes sont brisées.

sw.L: Mashujaa wa Babeli wameacha kupigana; wanakaa ngomeni; \q nguvu zao zimekauka; wamekuwa wanawake; \q makao yake yamechomwa moto; makomeo yake yamevunjika.
sw.B: Mashujaa wa Babeli wameacha kupigana; wamekaa ndani ya ngome zao. \q Nguvu zao zimekwisha; wamekuwa kama wanawake. \q Nyumba zake zimechomwa moto; makomeo ya malango yake yamevunjika.
sw.R: Askari wa Babeli wameacha kupigana. Wanakaa ndani ya ngome zao. \q Nguvu zao zimekwisha. Wamepoteza ujasiri wao wote. \q Nyumba zake zinaungua. Makomeo yanayofunga malango yake yamevunjika.

decisions.choice: they have become women: they have lost their nerve for battle
decisions.reason: In the language of ancient war, to say that soldiers "become women" meant that they had lost the strength and courage to fight and had become helpless (50:37; Isaiah 19:16; Nahum 3:13). The saying reflects the warfare of the time, in which women did not fight; it describes fear, not a judgment on women.

decisions.choice: the strongholds: the fortresses where they shelter
decisions.reason: The warriors do not go out to fight but stay behind their walls, which do not save them.

decisions.choice: her bars: the bars that lock the city gates
decisions.reason: Gates were closed with heavy bars of wood or bronze (49:31; Lamentations 2:9). Broken bars mean the city lies open.

decisions.choice: like women (B); They have lost all their courage (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced adds "like" to mark the comparison; Readable says what the idiom means (m1). Balanced and Readable say "the bars of her gates" to make the picture clear.

source.text: רָ֤ץ לִקְרַאת־רָץ֙ יָר֔וּץ וּמַגִּ֖יד לִקְרַ֣את מַגִּ֑יד לְהַגִּיד֙ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל כִּֽי־נִלְכְּדָ֥ה עִיר֖וֹ מִקָּצֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Runner to meet runner runs, and messenger to meet messenger, to tell [the] king of Babylon that has been captured his city from [the] end.

en.L: Runner runs to meet runner, \q and messenger to meet messenger, \q to tell the king of Babylon \q that his city has been captured from end [to end].
en.B: One runner runs to meet another, \q one messenger to meet the next, \q to tell the king of Babylon \q that his city has been taken from end to end.
en.R: One runner after another hurries to the king of Babylon. \q One messenger after another comes with news. \q They tell the king \q that his whole city has been captured.

es.L: Corredor corre al encuentro de corredor, \q y mensajero al encuentro de mensajero, \q para anunciar al rey de Babilonia \q que su ciudad ha sido tomada de un extremo [a otro].
es.B: Un corredor corre al encuentro de otro, \q un mensajero al encuentro del siguiente, \q para anunciar al rey de Babilonia \q que su ciudad ha sido tomada de un extremo a otro.
es.R: Un corredor tras otro corre hacia el rey de Babilonia. \q Un mensajero tras otro llega con noticias. \q Le dicen al rey \q que toda su ciudad ha sido conquistada.

fr.L: Le coureur court à la rencontre du coureur, \q et le messager à la rencontre du messager, \q pour annoncer au roi de Babylone \q que sa ville est prise d’un bout [à l’autre].
fr.B: Un coureur court au-devant d’un autre, \q un messager au-devant d’un autre messager, \q pour annoncer au roi de Babylone \q que sa ville est prise d’un bout à l’autre.
fr.R: Les coureurs se succèdent auprès du roi de Babylone. \q Les messagers arrivent l’un après l’autre avec des nouvelles. \q Ils annoncent au roi \q que toute sa ville a été prise.

sw.L: Tarishi anakimbia kumlaki tarishi, \q na mjumbe kumlaki mjumbe, \q kumwambia mfalme wa Babeli \q kwamba mji wake umetwaliwa kutoka mwisho [hadi mwisho].
sw.B: Tarishi mmoja anakimbia kumlaki mwingine, \q mjumbe mmoja kumlaki mwenzake, \q kumwambia mfalme wa Babeli \q kwamba mji wake umetekwa kutoka mwisho hadi mwisho.
sw.R: Tarishi mmoja baada ya mwingine wanakimbia kwa mfalme wa Babeli. \q Mjumbe mmoja baada ya mwingine wanakuja na habari. \q Wanamwambia mfalme \q kwamba mji wake wote umetekwa.

decisions.choice: runner to meet runner: messengers coming one after another from every part of the city
decisions.reason: Kings received news by runners (2 Samuel 18:19-27). Here they meet one another on the way, each bringing word from a different quarter, until the king learns that the whole city has fallen.

decisions.choice: from end to end: from every side, the whole city
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "from the end", meaning from its outer edge, on every side (50:26).

decisions.choice: from end [to end]
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the words English needs for the phrase (m2).

source.text: וְהַמַּעְבָּר֣וֹת נִתְפָּ֔שׂוּ וְאֶת־הָאֲגַמִּ֖ים שָׂרְפ֣וּ בָאֵ֑שׁ וְאַנְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה נִבְהָֽלוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And the fords have been seized, and the reed marshes they have burned with fire, and the men of war are terrified.

en.L: And the fords have been seized, \q and the reed marshes they have burned with fire, \q and the men of war are terrified.
en.B: The river crossings are seized, \q the marshes of reeds are set on fire, \q and the soldiers are in panic.
en.R: The enemy has taken the places where people cross the river. \q They have set fire to the reeds in the marshes. \q Babylon's soldiers are terrified.

es.L: Y los vados han sido tomados, \q y los cañaverales quemados con fuego, \q y los hombres de guerra están aterrados.
es.B: Los pasos del río han sido tomados, \q los cañaverales de los pantanos arden en llamas, \q y los soldados están llenos de pánico.
es.R: El enemigo ha tomado los lugares por donde la gente cruza el río. \q Han prendido fuego a los juncos de los pantanos. \q Los soldados de Babilonia están aterrados.

fr.L: Et les gués ont été saisis, \q et les marais de roseaux, on les a brûlés par le feu, \q et les hommes de guerre sont épouvantés.
fr.B: Les passages du fleuve sont occupés, \q les marais de roseaux sont livrés aux flammes, \q et les soldats sont pris de panique.
fr.R: L’ennemi a pris les endroits où l’on traverse le fleuve. \q Ils ont mis le feu aux roseaux des marais. \q Les soldats de Babylone sont terrifiés.

sw.L: Na vivuko vimekamatwa, \q na matete ya madimbwi wameyachoma kwa moto, \q na watu wa vita wametishika.
sw.B: Vivuko vya mto vimetekwa, \q matete ya madimbwi yamechomwa moto, \q na askari wamejaa hofu.
sw.R: Adui wameyateka mahali ambapo watu huvuka mto. \q Wameyachoma moto matete ya madimbwi. \q Askari wa Babeli wanaogopa sana.

decisions.choice: the fords: the river crossings
decisions.reason: The word names places where a river can be crossed (Judges 3:28; 12:5). Once they are held, no help can come and no one can escape.

decisions.choice: the reed marshes burned: the cover of the city's waters destroyed
decisions.reason: The word usually means pools or marshes thick with reeds (Exodus 7:19; Isaiah 35:7). Burning them may mean burning the reeds that grew along Babylon's waters and gave cover or defense. "Burned" is a vivid way to say that the city's water defenses are lost.

decisions.choice: The enemy has taken
decisions.reason: Readable names who seizes the fords, which the passive verb leaves unstated.

source.text: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בַּת־בָּבֶ֕ל כְּגֹ֖רֶן עֵ֣ת הִדְרִיכָ֑הּ ע֣וֹד מְעַ֔ט וּבָ֥אָה עֵֽת־הַקָּצִ֖יר לָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh of hosts, [the] God of Israel: [The] daughter of Babylon [is] like a threshing floor [at the] time of trampling her; yet a little, and will come [the] time of the harvest for her.

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, the God of Israel: \q The daughter of Babylon [is] like a threshing floor at the time it is trodden; \q yet a little while, \q and the time of harvest will come for her.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says this: \q Daughter Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time it is stamped down; \q in a little while \q the time of her harvest will come.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says: \q The city of Babylon is like a threshing floor that is being stamped hard and flat. \q Very soon \q it will be time to harvest her.

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: \q La hija de Babilonia [es] como una era en el tiempo en que la trillan; \q dentro de poco \q le llegará el tiempo de la siega.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, dice esto: \q La hija de Babilonia es como una era cuando se la apisona; \q dentro de poco \q le llegará el tiempo de la cosecha.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: \q La ciudad de Babilonia es como una era que están pisando hasta dejarla dura y plana. \q Muy pronto \q llegará el tiempo de cosecharla.

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : \q La fille de Babylone [est] comme une aire au moment où on la foule ; \q encore un peu de temps, \q et le temps de la moisson viendra pour elle.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, dit ceci : \q La fille de Babylone est comme une aire au moment où on la piétine ; \q encore un peu \q et le temps de sa moisson viendra.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : \q La ville de Babylone est comme une aire de battage qu’on tasse pour la rendre dure et plate. \q Très bientôt, \q ce sera le moment de la moissonner.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi, Mungu wa Israeli: \q Binti Babeli [ni] kama sakafu ya kupuria wakati inapokanyagwa; \q bado kitambo kidogo, \q na wakati wa mavuno utamjia.
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, asemavyo: \q Binti Babeli ni kama sakafu ya kupuria wakati inapokanyagwa; \q bado kitambo kidogo \q wakati wa mavuno yake utafika.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, analosema: \q Mji wa Babeli ni kama sakafu ya kupuria inayokanyagwa ikawa ngumu na sawa. \q Hivi karibuni \q utafika wakati wa kumvuna.

decisions.choice: a threshing floor at the time it is trodden: ready for the grain to be beaten
decisions.reason: A threshing floor was a flat place of hard earth or rock. Before harvest it was stamped down to make it smooth and firm; then the cut grain was spread on it and beaten (Isaiah 21:10; Micah 4:12-13). Babylon is being made ready for the threshing.

decisions.choice: the time of harvest: the time of judgment
decisions.reason: Harvest is a common picture of God's judgment on a people (Joel 4:13; Isaiah 17:5; Revelation 14:15).

decisions.choice: the daughter of Babylon: Babylon pictured as a woman
decisions.reason: As "Daughter Zion" is Jerusalem and its people, "Daughter Babylon" is the city personified (50:42; Isaiah 47:1).

decisions.choice: The city of Babylon
decisions.reason: Readable explains "Daughter Babylon" as the city, as Isaiah's terms list says to do.

decisions.choice: la hija de Babilonia (L, B); la ciudad de Babilonia (R)
decisions.reason: Daughter Babylon in the wording set for daughter Zion.

source.text: אֲכָלַ֣נִי הֲמָמַ֗נִי נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּר֮ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶל֒ הִצִּיגַ֨נִי֙ כְּלִ֣י רִ֔יק בְּלָעַ֨נִי֙ כַּתַּנִּ֔ין מִלָּ֥א כְרֵשׂ֖וֹ מֵֽעֲדָנָ֑י הֱדִיחָֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: He devoured me, he crushed me, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; he set me down [as] an empty vessel; he swallowed me like the sea monster; he filled his belly with my delicacies; he rinsed me out.

en.L: "He has devoured me, he has crushed me, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; \q he has set me down [like] an empty vessel; \q he has swallowed me like the sea monster; \q he has filled his belly with my delicacies; \q he has rinsed me out."
en.B: "Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon has devoured me and crushed me; \q he has left me standing like an empty jar. \q He has swallowed me like a sea monster, \q filled his belly with my good things, \q and spewed me out."
en.R: "Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon has eaten me up. He has crushed me. \q He left me empty, like a jar with nothing in it. \q He swallowed me like a great sea monster. \q He filled his stomach with my best things. \q Then he spit me out."

es.L: «Me devoró, me quebrantó Nabucodorosor, rey de Babilonia; \q me dejó [como] vasija vacía; \q me tragó como el monstruo marino; \q llenó su vientre de mis delicias; \q me echó fuera».
es.B: «Nabucodorosor, rey de Babilonia, me devoró y me aplastó; \q me dejó como un cántaro vacío. \q Me tragó como un monstruo marino, \q llenó su vientre con mis cosas buenas \q y me vomitó».
es.R: «Nabucodorosor, rey de Babilonia, se me comió. Me aplastó. \q Me dejó vacía, como un cántaro sin nada dentro. \q Me tragó como un gran monstruo del mar. \q Llenó su estómago con lo mejor que yo tenía. \q Después me escupió».

fr.L: « Il m’a dévorée, il m’a broyée, Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone ; \q il m’a posée [comme] un vase vide ; \q il m’a engloutie comme le monstre marin ; \q il a rempli son ventre de mes délices ; \q il m’a rejetée.
fr.B: « Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, m’a dévorée et m’a broyée ; \q il m’a laissée là comme une jarre vide. \q Il m’a engloutie comme un monstre marin, \q il s’est rempli le ventre de mes bonnes choses, \q et il m’a rejetée.
fr.R: « Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, m’a dévorée. Il m’a écrasée. \q Il m’a laissée vide, comme une jarre où il n’y a plus rien. \q Il m’a avalée comme un énorme monstre marin. \q Il s’est rempli l’estomac de mes meilleures choses. \q Puis il m’a recrachée.

sw.L: "Amenila, amenipondaponda, Nebukadreza mfalme wa Babeli; \q ameniweka chini [kama] chombo kitupu; \q amenimeza kama joka la bahari; \q amelijaza tumbo lake kwa vitu vyangu vitamu; \q amenisuuza nje."
sw.B: "Nebukadreza mfalme wa Babeli amenila na kunipondaponda; \q ameniacha kama mtungi mtupu. \q Amenimeza kama joka la bahari, \q amelijaza tumbo lake kwa vitu vyangu vizuri, \q na kunitapika nje."
sw.R: "Nebukadreza mfalme wa Babeli amenila. Amenipondaponda. \q Ameniacha mtupu, kama mtungi usio na kitu ndani. \q Amenimeza kama joka kubwa la baharini. \q Amelijaza tumbo lake kwa vitu vyangu bora. \q Kisha akanitema nje."

decisions.choice: me: Zion, speaking as a woman wronged by Babylon
decisions.reason: The speaker is named in verse 35: the people of Zion, Jerusalem. The city speaks of herself as one person, as in Lamentations 1:12-22. The LORD answers her in verse 36.

decisions.choice: me: the text as read; the written text says "us"
decisions.reason: In the written text the verbs end "us": he devoured us, crushed us, set us down, swallowed us, rinsed us out. The text as read changes each to "me", to match "my delicacies" and verse 35, where Zion speaks as one. Both mean the same people.

decisions.choice: the sea monster ... rinsed me out: the dragon that swallows its prey whole
decisions.reason: The word names a great sea creature or dragon (Genesis 1:21; Isaiah 27:1). Babylon has swallowed Jerusalem as such a beast swallows its prey and spits out what is left. The last verb means to rinse or wash out, here of a vessel emptied or a mouth spitting out. Verse 44 answers: Bel will be made to give back what he swallowed.

decisions.choice: Nebuchadrezzar: the form of the name used in this verse
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here spells the king's name with an "r", as in most of Jeremiah. It is the same king as Nebuchadnezzar (27:6).

decisions.choice: double quotation marks for Zion's words, closing at the end of verse 35
decisions.reason: Zion's complaint is speech quoted inside the oracle, so it takes double quotation marks, with "the inhabitant of Zion will say" in verse 35 outside them. Balanced and Readable put the king's name first, as English needs a subject at the start.

decisions.choice: « » for Zion's words in verses 34-35
decisions.reason: Zion herself speaks here, so her complaint takes quotation marks within the oracle; Readable makes the speaker feminine ("vacía") as the city.

decisions.choice: double quotation marks for Zion's words, closing at the end of verse 35, as the English
decisions.reason: The words are Zion's complaint, quoted inside the oracle.

decisions.choice: « » for Zion’s words in verses 34-35
decisions.reason: Zion speaks as a woman ("m’a dévorée"); her words are quoted speech inside the oracle and take French quotation marks, closing in verse 35 as the English does.

source.text: חֲמָסִ֤י וּשְׁאֵרִי֙ עַל־בָּבֶ֔ל תֹּאמַ֖ר יֹשֶׁ֣בֶת צִיּ֑וֹן וְדָמִי֙ אֶל־יֹשְׁבֵ֣י כַשְׂדִּ֔ים תֹּאמַ֖ר יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: My violence and my flesh [be] on Babylon, will say [the] inhabitant of Zion; and my blood [be] on [the] inhabitants of Chaldea, will say Jerusalem.

en.L: "The violence done to me and to my flesh [be] on Babylon," \q the inhabitant of Zion will say; \q "and my blood [be] on the inhabitants of Chaldea," \q Jerusalem will say.
en.B: "May the violence done to me and to my flesh fall on Babylon," \q the people of Zion will say. \q "May my blood be on those who live in Chaldea," \q Jerusalem will say.
en.R: The people of Zion will say, \q "May Babylon suffer the cruel things she did to us." \q The people of Jerusalem will say, \q "Babylon killed our people. May she pay for it."

es.L: «La violencia [hecha] a mí y a mi carne [caiga] sobre Babilonia», \q dirá la moradora de Sion; \q «y mi sangre sobre los habitantes de Caldea», \q dirá Jerusalén.
es.B: «Que la violencia hecha a mí y a mi carne caiga sobre Babilonia», \q dirá la gente de Sion. \q «Que mi sangre caiga sobre los que viven en Caldea», \q dirá Jerusalén.
es.R: La gente de Sion dirá: \q «Que Babilonia sufra las crueldades que nos hizo». \q La gente de Jerusalén dirá: \q «Babilonia mató a los nuestros. Que lo pague».

fr.L: Que la violence faite à moi et à ma chair [retombe] sur Babylone, \q dira l’habitante de Sion ; \q et que mon sang [soit] sur les habitants de la Chaldée ! » \q dira Jérusalem.
fr.B: Que la violence faite à moi et à ma chair retombe sur Babylone, \q dira la population de Sion. \q Que mon sang retombe sur ceux qui habitent la Chaldée ! » \q dira Jérusalem.
fr.R: Les habitants de Sion diront : \q “Que Babylone subisse le mal qu’elle nous a fait.” \q Les habitants de Jérusalem diront : \q “Babylone a tué les nôtres. Qu’elle le paie !” »

sw.L: "Udhalimu niliotendewa mimi na mwili wangu [na uwe] juu ya Babeli," \q mkaaji wa Sayuni atasema; \q "na damu yangu [iwe] juu ya wakaaji wa Ukaldayo," \q Yerusalemu itasema.
sw.B: "Udhalimu niliotendewa mimi na mwili wangu na umwangukie Babeli," \q watu wa Sayuni watasema. \q "Damu yangu na iwe juu ya wanaoishi Ukaldayo," \q Yerusalemu itasema.
sw.R: Watu wa Sayuni watasema, \q "Babeli na apate mateso yale ya kikatili aliyotutendea." \q Watu wa Yerusalemu watasema, \q "Babeli aliwaua watu wetu. Na alipe kwa ajili ya jambo hilo."

decisions.choice: the violence done to me ... my blood be on: let the guilt and its punishment fall on them
decisions.reason: "Violence done to me" means the wrong done to me (Genesis 16:5). To say "my blood be on" someone is to call for him to answer for the bloodshed (26:15; 2 Samuel 1:16; Matthew 27:25). Zion asks God to bring on Babylon what she suffered.

decisions.choice: my flesh: my own body, or my own people
decisions.reason: The word means flesh, and can also mean one's own kin (Leviticus 18:6). It may mean Zion's own body torn by Babylon, or her people killed.

decisions.choice: the inhabitant of Zion: Zion's people, spoken of as one woman
decisions.reason: The form is singular and feminine, the population pictured as a woman, like "Daughter Zion".

decisions.choice: the violence done to me (L, B); May ... (B, R)
decisions.reason: English says whose violence is meant and makes the wish clear with "[be]" at Literal and "May" at Balanced and Readable. Readable says "us" and "our people" for the city's people and puts the speaker first.

source.text: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְנִי־רָב֙ אֶת־רִיבֵ֔ךְ וְנִקַּמְתִּ֖י אֶת־נִקְמָתֵ֑ךְ וְהַחֲרַבְתִּי֙ אֶת־יַמָּ֔הּ וְהֹבַשְׁתִּ֖י אֶת־מְקוֹרָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore thus says Yahweh: Here I [am] pleading your case, and I will avenge your vengeance; and I will dry up her sea and make dry her spring.

en.L: Therefore thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: \q Look, I will plead your case \q and take vengeance for you; \q and I will dry up her sea \q and make her spring dry.
en.B: Therefore {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this: \q I will plead your case \q and avenge you. \q I will dry up her sea \q and leave her spring dry.
en.R: So this is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says to Jerusalem: \q I will stand up for you in court. \q I will pay Babylon back for what she did to you. \q I will dry up her sea. \q I will make her springs run dry.

es.L: Por tanto, así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q He aquí, yo defenderé tu causa \q y te vengaré; \q y secaré su mar \q y haré que se seque su manantial.
es.B: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: \q Yo defenderé tu causa \q y te vengaré. \q Secaré su mar \q y dejaré seco su manantial.
es.R: Por eso, esto es lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dice a Jerusalén: \q Yo te defenderé ante el tribunal. \q Le daré a Babilonia su merecido por lo que te hizo. \q Secaré su mar. \q Haré que sus manantiales se sequen.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi, ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Voici, je défendrai ta cause \q et j’exercerai ta vengeance ; \q et je mettrai à sec sa mer \q et je ferai tarir sa source.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : \q Je défendrai ta cause \q et je te vengerai. \q Je mettrai sa mer à sec \q et je ferai tarir sa source.
fr.R: Alors voici ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Jérusalem : \q Je prendrai ta défense au tribunal. \q Je ferai payer Babylone pour ce qu’elle t’a fait. \q Je mettrai sa mer à sec. \q Je ferai tarir ses sources.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: \q Tazama, nitakutetea katika shauri lako \q na kukulipizia kisasi; \q nami nitaikausha bahari yake \q na kuifanya chemchemi yake kavu.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: \q Nitakutetea katika shauri lako \q na kukulipizia kisasi. \q Nitaikausha bahari yake \q na kuiacha chemchemi yake ikiwa kavu.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analoiambia Yerusalemu: \q Nitakutetea mahakamani. \q Nitamlipiza Babeli kwa yale aliyokutendea. \q Nitaikausha bahari yake. \q Nitazifanya chemchemi zake zikauke.

decisions.choice: plead your case: take up your cause as in a court of law
decisions.reason: The words picture a lawsuit in which the LORD speaks for the one wronged and wins her case (50:34; Micah 7:9; Lamentations 3:58). "Your" is feminine singular, Zion who has just spoken.

decisions.choice: her sea ... her spring: the waters that made Babylon great
decisions.reason: Babylon's "sea" is the Euphrates with its canals and marshes, the "many waters" of verse 13 (Isaiah 21:1). Drying them up takes away her wealth and defense (50:38; Isaiah 44:27).

decisions.choice: to Jerusalem; stand up for you in court
decisions.reason: Readable names whom the LORD speaks to and explains "plead your case" (m1).
